# Code of conduct

This covers the repository: issues, pull requests, reviews and any other discussion here.
Behaviour **in the app** — deadlines, class reports, and who can post them — is governed by
the [terms of use](https://stephen316.github.io/DCU-Timetables/terms.html), not this page.

## Expected

- Be respectful and assume good faith. Most people here are students with limited time.
- Keep feedback about the code and the idea, not the person.
- Accept that the maintainer decides what gets merged, and why.

## Not accepted

- Harassment, insults, or discriminatory, sexual or threatening language.
- Posting anyone's personal information — including student numbers, emails or
  timetables — without their permission.
- Spam, or repeatedly pushing a point after a decision has been made.

## Enforcement

Report problems to **stephenharcourt6@gmail.com**. Reports are kept confidential.
Depending on how serious it is, the maintainer may edit or delete comments, lock threads,
or block someone from the repository.
